# Commit map: history rewrite of 2026-10-23

On 2026-10-23 this repository's history was rewritten before publication:
commit metadata was normalised to a single author, and an obsolete draft
manuscript was removed from every commit. Every commit was kept, with its
original date, message and content otherwise unchanged, so the order in
which files were committed (for example, analysis protocols frozen before
their results) is preserved. Commit IDs changed.

Run records written before the rewrite store the old IDs. This table maps
each old ID to its new one (old, then new, newest first).
